heroes.role: Long range damage. Fragile, so she needs healing or protection on a long walk.
heroes.split: Guides split by plan. Unicorn is the pick for Queen Charge, while TH18 war armies mostly run Frosty. GameRant and one TH18 army use Sneezy, but Clash Ninja warns it exposes her to Air Defenses.

picks.why: Heals her through a long Queen Charge.
Slows the defences shooting at her.
Clash Ninja calls it a powerful combination: it breaks the walls that would block her.
A backup that survives one big burst.

avoid.why: Her range is longer than its 4.5 tiles, so it runs ahead of her (Clash Ninja).

heroes.role: Support. His ability protects the army from big hits, and he can walk or fly over walls.
heroes.split: Sneezy leads at TH17 and up. AllClash still prefers Electro Owl in air mode and Poison Lizard in ground mode.

picks.why: Boogers soak up hits meant for him. Clash Ninja says air mode only.
Long range suits air mode. The usual pick below TH17.
The usual pick for ground mode.
Strong for Warden Walks and Fireball.
Stays protected behind the troops.

avoid.why: He's rarely in danger, so its revive is mostly wasted (Clash Ninja).
His range is longer than its 4.5 tiles (Clash Ninja).

heroes.role: Dives over walls and hits defences alone, so staying alive decides how far she gets.
heroes.split: The most disputed hero. AllClash calls Diggy the best pairing in the game, GameRant picks Spirit Fox, Base Drop picks Phoenix, and Clash Ninja backs L.A.S.S.I, Diggy and Spirit Fox.

picks.why: Invisibility lets her dive defences and reset Infernos.
She goes deep alone, so a second life pays off.
Stuns the defences she goes for.
Clash Ninja calls it a strong combination: it can get ahead of her and tank.
Healing, before the better pets unlock.

avoid.why: She already goes for defences, so it adds nothing (Clash Ninja).
It leads her into Air Defenses (Clash Ninja).

heroes.role: Tanky flying hero. He gets stronger when separated from friendly flying units.
heroes.split: Angry Jelly leads for clearing defences. 1337wiki's Duke Charge armies use Spirit Fox.

picks.why: Keeps him attacking defences.
Invisibility on a Duke Charge.
Extra survival.
Hangs back, so defences rarely target it.

avoid.why: AllClash and Clash Ninja both say its Boogers stop his enrage.
A ground pet can't keep up with a flying hero. Clash Ninja says the same of Unicorn and Frosty.

heroes.role: Tough melee tank. Good for taking down a corner and making a funnel.
heroes.split: Most guides favour Frosty or Phoenix. Base Drop picks Spirit Fox first instead.

picks.why: Slows the defences wearing him down.
A second chance to finish a compartment.
Invisibility through the first ring of defences.
Clears defences early on.
Opens walls and compartments up close.

avoid.why: It runs ahead and dies (Clash Ninja).
His short range leaves it exposed to Air Defenses (Clash Ninja).
It gets exposed to Air Defenses (Clash Ninja).

heroes.role: Flying damage dealer that can stay with an air army.
heroes.split: AllClash and GameRant pick Angry Jelly. Base Drop picks Electro Owl, and Clash Ninja rates both.

picks.why: Lets him charge with an air army and clear defences.
A fallback for survival.
Matches his ranged attack. The pick before Angry Jelly unlocks.
Stuns defences while it digs.

avoid.why: Close range, and a poor fit for a flying hero (Clash Ninja).

pets.L.A.S.S.I: Best on the Royal Champion, where it can get ahead and tank. On the King it runs ahead and dies.
pets.Electro Owl: Long range support. The early favourite for the Warden.
pets.Mighty Yak: Opens compartments for a King going in close.
pets.Unicorn: Healing. The classic Queen Charge partner.
pets.Frosty: Slows defences. A popular all-round war pet.
pets.Diggy: Rated very differently between guides. Strongest with the Royal Champion.
pets.Poison Lizard: Fast and slows defences. Suits a ground mode Warden.
pets.Phoenix: Saves a hero from one big hit. Best on heroes that dive alone.
pets.Spirit Fox: Invisibility on a hero that needs to get deep.
pets.Angry Jelly: Turns the hero onto defences. Top pick for Dragon Duke and Minion Prince.
pets.Sneezy: Boogers take hits for the hero. Best on a Warden in air mode. Avoid on the King, Queen and Dragon Duke.
pets.Greedy Raven: A farming pet that hits resource buildings. Swap it out for war, unless your plan needs its storage damage.

townHalls.summary: Tanks in front, damage behind, and your first Wall Breakers.

strategies.name: Giants and Archers
strategies.about: Giants soak up the hits while Archers do the damage. Wall Breakers open a way in.
steps: Send Giants first, at the defences.
Use Wall Breakers to reach the Mortar early.
Spread Archers behind the Giants, and use the last ones to clean up.

townHalls.summary: Balloons are strong while anti-air is thin.

strategies.name: Balloons and Archers
strategies.about: Balloons go straight for defences, and most bases here have little to stop them.
steps: Clear the Air Defense and Archer Towers first, as they are the Balloons' main threat.
Send the Balloons together.
Finish with Archers.

townHalls.summary: Mix ground and air, and start using spells.

strategies.name: Giants, Wizards and Balloons
strategies.about: A ground push takes out the Air Defense, then Balloons finish from the other side.
steps: Push Giants and Wizards towards the Air Defense.
Break walls with Wall Breakers.
Send Balloons from the opposite side once it falls.

townHalls.summary: Air gets harder with more Air Defenses and the Air Sweeper, so go by ground.

strategies.name: Giant and Wizard push
strategies.about: A full ground push with Healing Spells. Skycoach warns that air is inconsistent at this level.
steps: Lead with Giants.
Follow with Wizards and open walls with Wall Breakers.
Drop Healing Spells on the push when it comes under fire.

townHalls.summary: Dragons arrive, and they are the safest three-star for several Town Halls.

strategies.name: Mass Dragons
strategies.about: The most forgiving war army at this level. Air Defenses are still few and weak.
steps: Snipe an Air Defense with Lightning first.
Deploy from behind the Air Sweeper, in a spread line.
Rage the Dragons when they reach the core.

strategies.name: Mass Hog Riders
strategies.about: A ground option that jumps walls. Traps matter more than with Dragons.
steps: Pull out or clear Clan Castle troops first.
Send Hog Riders together.
Heal them where splash and traps hit.

townHalls.summary: Time ground attacks with the Queen, or stay on Dragons.

strategies.name: Mass Dragons
strategies.about: Still a strong beginner army here, and it needs no new skills.
steps: Take out an Air Defense with Lightning.
Deploy in a spread line.
Rage the core.

strategies.name: GoHo
strategies.about: Golems, Hog Riders and Wizards. Teaches timing and spell placement.
steps: Golem tanks one side while Wizards clear a funnel.
Send Hog Riders through the gap.
Heal the Hogs where defences overlap.

strategies.name: Golem and Valkyrie push
strategies.about: A structured ground push that pays off against strong cores.
steps: Golems take the hits.
Open the core with Wall Breakers.
Send Valkyries in, with Rage on arrival.

townHalls.summary: Witches reward steady pressure, and Lava Hounds open up air.

strategies.name: Witch Slap
strategies.about: Golems in front and Witches behind. It wins by pressure more than precision.
steps: Golems first, to take the fire.
Open a path with Wall Breakers or Jump.
Deploy Witches behind them, then Rage, Freeze and Heal as needed.

strategies.name: Zap Dragons
strategies.about: Spells clear the Air Defenses, then the Dragons have an easy run.
steps: Earthquake and Lightning an Air Defense.
Use heroes on the remaining Air Defenses.
Deploy the Dragons.

strategies.name: Zap Lalo
strategies.about: Lava Hounds tank for Balloons. Strong, but needs precise timing.
steps: Zap an Air Defense with Lightning.
Send the King and Queen at high-value defences.
Lava Hounds first, Balloons close behind.

townHalls.summary: Inferno Towers arrive. Zap Dragons stays simple, and Queen Charge starts here.

strategies.name: Zap Dragons
strategies.about: Remove the Air Defenses before the Dragons deploy. Low risk.
steps: Lightning and Earthquake the Air Defenses.
Use the Queen and Prince on what remains.
Deploy the Dragons.

strategies.name: Queen Charge Hybrid
strategies.about: The Queen with Healers clears one side, then Hog Riders and Miners finish. It adapts to most bases.
steps: Walk the Queen with her Healers, keeping her clear of single-target Inferno Towers.
Use Healing Spells to keep her alive.
Send Hog Riders and Miners together once the path is clear.

strategies.name: Zap Lalo
strategies.about: A classic air three-star for players who already know their timing.
steps: Zap Air Defenses with Lightning.
Send Lava Hounds first.
Balloons behind them, with Haste and Heal.

townHalls.summary: Zap Witches is the easy three-star. The Warden and Eagle Artillery change planning.

strategies.name: Zap Witches
strategies.about: Very forgiving. Spells take out the Inferno Towers, then Witches walk through.
steps: Lightning and Earthquake the Inferno Towers.
Make a wide funnel.
Send Golems, then Witches and heroes through the centre. Use the Warden's ability when the push takes heavy damage.

strategies.name: Electro Dragons
strategies.about: One of the easier air armies. Chain lightning works best in a straight line.
steps: Funnel with heroes or one Electro Dragon.
Send the rest in a straight line, with Balloons on the defences in their way.
Rage and Freeze along the path.

strategies.name: Queen Charge Hybrid
strategies.about: The versatile option for skilled players. Higher reward, less forgiving.
steps: Queen and Healers clear one side.
Use Healing Spells and the Warden's ability to keep her alive.
Send Hog Riders and Miners to finish.

townHalls.summary: Siege machines arrive and make air attacks more controlled.

strategies.name: Zap Dragons
strategies.about: Simple and reliable, and it doesn't need epic equipment.
steps: Use Giant Arrow, Lightning and Earthquake on the Air Defenses.
Funnel with the King.
Deploy the Dragons, with a Battle Blimp on the core. Rage and Freeze when needed.

strategies.name: Yeti Smash
strategies.about: A ground alternative. Yetis and their Yetimites overwhelm the defences behind a tank.
steps: Make a funnel with heroes.
Send the Yetis behind an Ice Golem, which takes the hits.
Rage and Freeze as they reach the core.

strategies.name: DragBat
strategies.about: Dragons weaken the splash defences, then Bat Spells swarm what's left. Timing decides it.
steps: Deploy Dragons with a Battle Blimp or Stone Slammer.
Wait until splash defences are gone.
Drop Bat Spells outside them, and Freeze what still threatens the Bats.

strategies.name: Queen Charge Hybrid
strategies.about: Still strong here if you can control the charge.
steps: Queen and Healers clear one side.
Heal her, and save the Warden's ability for big hits.
Send Hog Riders and Miners to finish.

townHalls.summary: The Royal Champion arrives, and Yetis are the ground answer.

strategies.name: Yeti Super Archer Spam
strategies.about: Simple to deploy, with a lot of forgiving damage.
steps: Ice Golems and heroes open the attack.
Send Yetis and a Log Launcher.
Super Archers behind them, Rage on the core.

strategies.name: Yeti and Super Wizard Smash
strategies.about: A heavy ground push. Keep the heroes grouped under the Warden's ability.
steps: Open a side with heroes and a Log Launcher.
Send Yetis then Super Wizards.
Use the Warden's ability when the group is under fire.

strategies.name: Super Archer Clone Hydra
strategies.about: One of the most reliable air attacks, but with several moving parts.
steps: Fly Super Archers in on a Battle Blimp, with Invisibility and Clone.
Send the Royal Champion at the back of the base.
Follow with a Lava Hound, Dragons, Balloons and Dragon Riders.

townHalls.summary: The Pet House opens. Most guides pick a Dragon army here.

strategies.name: Super Dragons
strategies.about: One of the most reliable armies here, and forgiving to deploy.
steps: Take out an Air Defense with the Queen or spells.
Deploy Super Dragons along one side.
Balloons on defences in the way, then Rage and Freeze.

strategies.name: Mass Dragons with Blimp
strategies.about: The Queen's Giant Arrow handles an Air Defense, and the Blimp goes for the Town Hall.
steps: Giant Arrow on an Air Defense.
Send the Battle Blimp towards the Town Hall.
Deploy Dragons with Balloons, then Rage and Freeze.

strategies.name: RC Walk Dragons
strategies.about: Very strong once the Champion's walk has cleared key defences.
steps: Walk the Royal Champion through defences with Rocket Spear, using Invisibility to keep her alive.
Clear Air Defenses with Rocket Balloons.
Deploy the Dragons.

townHalls.summary: Root Riders and Dragon Duke arrive, and ground smash takes over.

strategies.name: Root Rider with RC Charge
strategies.about: Trophy Coach calls it the most consistent high Town Hall ground army of 2026, and the default when unsure.
steps: Charge the Royal Champion along one side.
Root Riders push through defences and walls.
Overgrowth keeps defences busy while the push gets through.

strategies.name: Warden Charge Super Yetis
strategies.about: The Warden leads with Healers, and Super Yetis push behind him.
steps: Open with the Warden and Healers.
Use Furnaces and Skeleton Spells to pull fire.
Send Super Yetis in behind, with Jump where walls block them.

strategies.name: Hydra
strategies.about: A triple air mix where pathing decides everything. Avoid the Clan Castle.
steps: Plan the path around the Clan Castle.
Drop Clone Spells where the Battle Blimp releases its troops.
Deploy Dragons, Dragon Riders and Balloons.

townHalls.note: Picked before Town Hall 19, which Supercell says lands in mid-November 2026. Expect these to change.
townHalls.summary: Merged defences arrive. Super Yetis and Root Riders lead.

strategies.name: Fireball Super Yeti
strategies.about: Blueprint CoC calls it safe and consistent, and Trophy Coach the most forgiving high Town Hall three-star.
steps: Soften defences with the Warden's Fireball.
Send Super Yetis with the King and Royal Champion.
Totem, Jump and Rage to carry the push into the core.

strategies.name: RC Walk Root Riders
strategies.about: Strong, but needs precise control of the Champion's walk.
steps: Walk the Royal Champion with Invisibility.
Send Root Riders along the cleared side.
Use Overgrowth and Totems to keep them going.

strategies.name: Root Riders and Valkyries
strategies.about: Controlled ground movement rather than spam.
steps: Clear space with a Siege Barracks.
Send Root Riders first, then Valkyries and Super Barbarians.
Use Overgrowth and Rage to control the path.

strategies.name: RC Walk Dragons
strategies.about: Fast and explosive when the walk takes out the right targets.
steps: Walk the Royal Champion with Invisibility.
Deploy Dragons on the opened side.
Clean up the rest.

townHalls.note: Picked before Town Hall 19, which Supercell says lands in mid-November 2026. Expect these to change.
townHalls.summary: Sneezy, Meteor Golem and the Firespitter. Precise entries matter more.

strategies.name: Fireball Super Yetis
strategies.about: Blueprint CoC calls it one of the most consistent smash attacks here.
steps: Use the Warden's Fireball, Invisibility and Earthquake to open the way in.
Ice Golems take the hits.
Send Super Yetis, with Jump into the core.

strategies.name: RC Walk Dragons
strategies.about: Extremely strong when the walk works. Invisibility is used on the spot to steer the Dragons' path.
steps: Walk the Royal Champion with Invisibility.
Clear defences with Rocket Balloons and a Siege Barracks.
Deploy Dragons, using Invisibility to steer them.

strategies.name: RC Walk Root Riders
strategies.about: Blueprint CoC calls it one of the strongest ground strategies here.
steps: Walk the Royal Champion with Invisibility.
Use a Troop Launcher to get support to her.
Send Root Riders with Overgrowth.

strategies.name: Hydra Air
strategies.about: A two-flank air attack that needs Air Defenses you can split.
steps: Check the Air Defenses can be split into two flanks.
Open with a Lava Hound and Balloons.
Send Dragons and Dragon Riders, with Rage, Freeze and Poison.

townHalls.note: Picked before Town Hall 19, which Supercell says lands in mid-November 2026. Expect these to change.
townHalls.summary: Supercell's July war data had Dragon armies and Throwers with Healers at about 40% of TH18 attacks between them.

strategies.name: Super Yeti with RC Charge
strategies.about: The most forgiving high Town Hall three-star, according to Trophy Coach.
steps: Soften defences with Fireball or a Log Launcher.
Send a tank and Super Yetis.
Charge the Royal Champion behind them with Electro Boots.

strategies.name: Root Rider Yeti
strategies.about: Root Riders push defences and Super Yetis push the core. Clustered troops are at risk from the Monolith, so plan to remove it early.
steps: The King and Giants make the funnel.
The Royal Champion pushes one side.
Send Root Riders, then Super Yetis into the core.

strategies.name: Dragon Duke Charge Hydra
strategies.about: From the most used army type in Supercell's July data. Fire Heart was nerfed in October, so older hit rates may flatter it.
steps: Charge the Dragon Duke along one side, using Invisibility.
Send Inferno Dragons, a Lava Hound and Rocket Balloons.
Dragon Riders follow, with Totem, Freeze and Poison.

strategies.name: Rocket Backpack Throwers
strategies.about: Throwers backed by Healers were the second most used army type in Supercell's July data.
steps: Open with the Dragon Duke on Rocket Backpack.
Open walls with Wall Breakers and clear the way with Lightning.
Send Throwers and Healers, with Totem, Overgrowth and Freeze.

strategies.name: Ruin Witch
strategies.about: Supercell put Ruin Witch attacks at about 76% three-stars, against a 53% average, before an October nerf to her Ruin Knights. Those figures may now flatter her.
steps: Make a funnel for them.
Deploy the Ruin Witches, which summon Ruin Knights.
Support the push with Rage and Freeze.
